feature_contract.goal: Preserve exact gameplay 6th/rank and other tagged ScreenHud GPU original-game WVP through reentrant native constant callbacks, ensuring that new queue glyphs cannot borrow an old source matrix and distort per-eye position.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only R84 direct/queued gameplay exact ScreenHud c64 source across original D3D9 native callback; preserve GOAL/+TIME D3DX, C993 lens, world stereo, SkyGlow, F11/ESC, original FFB/input, R26_SAFE rollback and DXVK freeze.
trace_stages: Original gameplay HUD call or Sumo SpriteNode publishes ScreenHud exact producer, node and queue epoch at the game source.
Game native SetVertexShaderConstantF can reenter queue/producer/shader without another c64 write; earlier implementation fenced only LensCentre and native write-generation.
R84 original raw game WVP admission and finite two-eye HUD placement accept only unchanged direct/queued source through the native callback.
subcomponents: Capture original ScreenHud direct and queued producer/queue identity plus shader epoch, pose and draw serial before and after both native partial and full c64 calls.

Revoke stale queued partial matrix rows and suppress full raw game WVP publication on source mutation, with executable source-positive and reentrant-negative regressions in the required x64 host build.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Original gameplay HUD producer and R84 finite stereo glyph placement
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Unchanged exact ScreenHud game c64 returns may publish raw WVP; a changed callback queue, direct producer or shader never attributes the prior game matrix to a newly selected glyph.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Nested producer transition, original GPU submit, world/centre flare and input
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Same-source native call continues to accept direct/queued HUD; changed node/epoch/pose/shader/draw is rejected atomically without changing native GPU HRESULT, world, GOAL/+TIME, FFB or SkyGlow.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Windows R84/R26_SAFE x86, x64 host regression/package and Domain/Inspector/Full Source gates
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: The host CI compiles and executes portable native callback tests; all unchanged exact-SHA mandatory workflows are required before BUILD_VERIFIED and Quest3 runtime remains separate UNTESTED.

diagnosis.root_cause: Game original c64 native callback return checked LensCentreUploadGeneration but did not check HUD producer, queue node/epoch, shader identity, pose or physical draw after a source-only reentrant callback.
diagnosis.original_evidence: In src/vr/game/outrun_renderer.cpp TrackQueuedHudWvp reads CurrentQueueNode and CurrentRenderProducerToken only after the original SetVertexShaderConstantF returned. The partial and full HUD paths lacked corresponding before/after provenance.
source_trace: Direct/queued HUD game tag enters original ScreenHud command owner.
Native game c64 setter invokes D3D9; nested source-only queue changes may occur while write generation stays fixed.
The post-native TrackQueuedHudWvp/RecordGameWvpWrite feed original WVP to the R84 two-eye screen plane.
alternatives_rejected: No global Flush, no broad tagging of unclassified alpha, no modified native HRESULT and no edits to lens, SkyGlow, FFB or frozen DXVK.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Source identity must remain stable from CPU original-game glyph to GPU WVP; otherwise the R84 binocular shader HUD preserves its native fallback and does not inherit foreign head-lock.

local_validation.planned: C++17 hud_native_source_transaction_smoke executable in mandatory Windows host CI

next_action: Exact-SHA Active/Domain/affected HUD and Full Source workflows must succeed; physical Quest3 remains UNTESTED.
